renovationPotentialInfoDialog.title: How is this estimate determined?
renovationPotentialInfoDialog.description: The initial estimate is based exclusively on the known construction year. Buildings constructed through 1983 are assigned high potential, buildings from 1984 through 1994 moderate potential, and newer buildings a tendency toward lower renovation potential. The possible heritage-protection notice is shown for construction years through 1948. In the following steps, you can review and supplement the building data. This estimate replaces neither professional energy advice nor verification of heritage status.

renovationPotential.title: Estimated Renovation Potential

descriptions.high: Based on the known construction year, the building is expected to have high energy-renovation potential.
descriptions.moderate: Based on the known construction year, the building is expected to have moderate energy-renovation potential.
descriptions.lower: Buildings from this construction period tend to have lower energy-renovation potential.
descriptions.unknown: Without a known construction year, the renovation potential cannot yet be estimated.

renovationPotential.basis: Initial estimate based on the construction year {{year}}.

heritageWarning.title: Possible heritage protection
heritageWarning.description: Special requirements may apply to older buildings. Before planning, please verify whether the building has protected heritage status.
